title: Parameterizing the effect of a continuous treatment using average derivative effects

split.decision: Materialized independent Section 5 SEM observations; full 40 replications at eight sample sizes per split; generation seeds and truth excluded from prediction input.

baseline.paper_ref: Historical source scaled MSE 3.0844; no full reference measured under this conversion.

allowed_changes: Nuisance fitting implementations, bases and smoothing within GAM, forest construction/tuning within the forest family, numerical optimization and variance estimation may change.
Valid ALSE estimation, sample splitting and cross-fitting may change while retaining both nuisance families; auxiliary fitting losses cannot redefine ALSE.
When retaining the supplied ranger nuisance-fitting routine, changing only num.trees=1000 does not count as a method improvement.
Only switching to the five-fold sample-splitting results the baseline already computes (`psi_0_2`, `std_err_0_2`) also does not count.
fixed_contract: Improve ALSE (Psi) estimation and uncertainty quantification under the two specified nuisance-learning conditions, GAM and random forest.
ALSE Psi = E[Cov(A,Y|X)] / E[Var(A|X)] is a variance-weighted average of conditional least-squares slopes. The unweighted psi = E[Cov(A,Y|X) / Var(A|X)] is distinct and is not scored.
Both nuisance-learning conditions (GAM and random forest), the eight sample sizes, each dataset, fixed Wald multiplier 1.959964, equal 16-cell n*MSE and coverage floors remain fixed.
Supplied data/splits, evaluation metric, trusted evaluator and lawful information access.
method_freedom_review.budget_policy: agent overall deadline; separate overall formal replay budget
forbidden_substitutions: Do not replace the GAM/forest experimental conditions with arbitrary neural predictors or one duplicate learner; their names are not cosmetic slots.
Do not substitute psi/another weighted derivative target, use known true Psi as a prediction, pool independent datasets or change the Wald/scoring rule.
Training or fitting reusable model state or learned preprocessing on validation features or labels, including final train+val refits or validation-based distillation.

evidence.finding: Simulation explicitly studies GAM with smooth interactions and random forest nuisance regression as two conditions for ALSE/psi methods.
ALSE and weighted derivative are distinct estimands; estimator/sample-splitting routines are computational methods.
Separate learner cells are checked and scored, but learner labels cannot authenticate architecture.

research_contract_review.verification_scope: Task-specific research-scope review and bounded checks; not a new performance/readiness certification.

validation_policy.learned_preprocessing: fit on training only; apply frozen fitted transforms to validation/test
validation_policy.instance_roles: Preserve explicit per-instance observation/training/calibration/causal-feedback roles; no evaluation-target fitting or validation-derived fitted state carried across independent cases.
validation_policy.enforcement: binding prompt and task contract; task-specific replay/guards where available; arbitrary training-data provenance requires source/patch audit
